question.text: What is the minimum corpus that a Cat I or Cat II AIF scheme must raise under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012?

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 10 of SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012 prescribes a minimum scheme corpus of INR 20 crore for every AIF scheme (including Cat I, Cat II and Cat III). Angel Funds (sub-category of Cat I VCF) have a lower threshold of INR 5 crore. The Trap: INR 10 cr is the Angel Fund Regulations 2013 pre-cursor. INR 25 cr and INR 50 cr overstate. Candidates often confuse this with the minimum investor contribution (INR 1 crore) or total net worth of sponsor. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A also tests this at the distributor level. The INR 20 crore figure is a frequent XIX-C repeat. Manager's Pro-Tip: A thinly-subscribed first close may fall short of INR 20 crore. Use a warehousing clause or sponsor top-up to meet the floor before deploying capital.
